input.title: IAttachmentStore and IAttachmentTransport are a bidirectional pair, and get() transparently re-fetches evicted bytes so it always succeeds for a known hash

input.description: The store calls announce/push when data arrives locally; the transport calls store.put() when it arrives from a remote. put() distinguishes no row, evicted and available; an unknown hash throws.
